rules.statement: facts.json holds fact id, home section, statement, covering entries, and exclusions with reasons - nothing else; never duplicate query text or expectations into the manifest
Each entry tests one fact cluster and carries id, query, expect rubric, and (iff {RUN_DIR} is used) fixtures - schema fixed by the worked example
The query asks for the task; only the rubric names the expected behavior
Fix failures by editing the doc - never by adding behavioral rules, prohibitions, or read-me-first discipline clauses; a reference failure means the information architecture failed
Proposal is one card per entry with exactly these lines in order (## N. <entry-id>, covers:, facts:, query:, expect:, why:), closed by coverage:/excluded:/cost:/fixtures: lines

Report is a fixed layout: retrieval test: <skill> - <date> header, queries:/artifacts:/manifest: lines, id/result/control table with status annotations, summary: N pass / M fail / G gap / V void, then failures:/gaps:/ablation flags:/regression failures: sections, closing with an ablation-candidates list

scored.json carries campaign, skill, and per-entry result/classification/control/ablation_flag/missed_bullets/notes; classification iff fail, missed_bullets required for fail and gap and absent otherwise, ablation_flag = (control == pass), every results id accounted exactly once
Never name the section or file holding the fact in a query - a query with a section hint tests following directions, not retrieval

excluded.reason: harness is user-specified with no default - a compliance-cost rule the agent rationalizes away under pressure; pressure-testing track, not shaping
eval agents pin no model/variant/temperature - compliance under pressure; pressure-testing track, not shaping
reps default 1 and timeout default 300 are documented defaults, not artifact-shaping rules
source-root derivation and default queries/facts paths are resolution mechanics, not output shape
one-run-per-scenario and force-load-by-instruction are process mechanics of the harness, not rules for a produced artifact
scope routing (trigger-testing questions, empty fact inventory) routes work to other tracks; no artifact shape at stake
the seven fact tests (directive/threshold/taxonomy/...) are inventory-building method, not output shape
drop rationales, dedupe, cluster, derive queries from failure modes are inventory-building method
frontmatter-convention guidance is always out of scope on the shape track; no anchor span in the body
inventory-mint id minting and --carry carry-forward are procedural mechanics enforced by the script
diff-driven workflow (new/changed/deleted/removed fact handling) is campaign process, not artifact shape
status/ablation semantics are manifest bookkeeping definitions, not shaping rules
id stability / never-reuse is identifier hygiene enforced by minting, not artifact shape
{RUN_DIR} token and fixtures list pairing is enforced by the harness pre-spend gate
inline-default, canonical fixtures/ dir, and per-run staging are harness staging mechanics
task text stays verbatim across campaigns - a compliance-cost verbatim freeze under pressure; pressure-testing track, not shaping
two-agent permission sets and {{SKILL_NAME}} substitution are install-time mechanics enforced by the installer
preflight, two workspaces, sync/status, campaign-init, and snapshot steps are campaign mechanics
control workspace is NEVER synced - compliance under temptation; pressure-testing track, not shaping
planned-spend confirmation every campaign - compliance under pressure; pressure-testing track, not shaping
one suite process at a time (lockfile) - compliance under deadline pressure; pressure-testing track, not shaping
evidence scoring mechanics (every bullet, worst-non-void for reps > 1) are scoring method, not artifact shape
confirm mini-campaign layout and results-superseded renaming are directory conventions enforced by the driver
close-out order score -> inventory-update -> verify -> record is campaign process
the classification-fix table (gap/findability/clarity/ablation rows) prescribes doc-edit strategy, not artifact form
fix between campaigns, never mid-campaign - compliance under pressure; pressure-testing track, not shaping
apply recommended edits only with user confirmation - compliance under pressure; pressure-testing track, not shaping
keep queries verbatim within and across campaigns - compliance-cost verbatim freeze; pressure-testing track, not shaping
3-consecutive-passes threshold and the 3-step removal are process policy, not artifact shape
fact-id minting and stability across campaigns are procedural mechanics enforced by inventory-mint
offline scoring via the scored-check skeleton/validate flow is driver process, not artifact shape
never put rubric text in a run prompt - compliance under pressure; pressure-testing track, not shaping
never let the eval agent know it is a test - compliance under pressure; pressure-testing track, not shaping
score from answer_text only - compliance under pressure; pressure-testing track, not shaping
campaign artifacts live in the persistent campaign dir, never the temp workspaces - harness directory mechanics
control pass is a flag not a verdict; missing skill-load is void not fail - scoring semantics, not artifact shape
